sections.Profile:
Suspense, released by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in May 1969, is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Norm Clark with artwork by Christian Marche.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1969
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Original Theme, Drama, Playfield Gimmick, Mystery, Single level playfield
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Christian Marche
- Concept: Norm Clark
- Design: Norm Clark
